purpose: Make Rank-1 identity, semantic coverage, abstention, OFF causes, action aliases, and failure responsibility measurable without rewarding an always-OFF policy.

rank1_definition.unit: one exact candidate identity per component and deployment-visible state after the frozen source-local retriever ranks the legal pool
rank1_definition.topk_role: Top-k identities and scores are audit-only; Step1 and Step2 may execute only the frozen actual Rank-1 for that component
rank1_definition.freeze_time: after the current state and legal strictly-prior catalog exist, before action, generation, paired outcome, or evaluation is read
rank1_definition.absence: if no structurally legal Rank-1 exists, that component is structurally OFF and the PM receives no semantic value label for it

fail_closed_policy.state_level_semantic_abstention: only the unresolved component bit is forced OFF; other qualified bits continue independently
fail_closed_policy.head_level_failure: a head failing label-support or cross-fitted learnability is fixed OFF in learned_pm_qualified for every state
fail_closed_policy.transparent_rule_boundary: transparent_rule is a separate named baseline only and is never substituted for a failed learned head
fail_closed_policy.current_v5_3: all four formal heads failed; no learned_pm_qualified external arm is authorized; a mechanical all-failed projection would alias always_off at M0+R0

candidate_availability_rate.numerator: states with a frozen structurally legal actual Rank-1 for the component
candidate_availability_rate.denominator: all deployment states in the named panel

structural_off_rate.numerator: states with candidate absent or structurally invalid
structural_off_rate.denominator: all deployment states in the named panel

semantic_resolution_coverage.numerator: structurally legal candidate states receiving resolved OPEN_ELIGIBLE or DO_NOT_OPEN
semantic_resolution_coverage.denominator: states with a structurally legal actual Rank-1

semantic_abstention_rate.numerator: structurally legal candidate states routed ABSTAIN for out-of-support or low-confidence semantics
semantic_abstention_rate.denominator: states with a structurally legal actual Rank-1

conditional_on_rate.numerator: final requested ON states for the component
conditional_on_rate.denominator: states with a structurally legal actual Rank-1
conditional_on_rate.owner: semantic interface plus PM plus joint projection

policy_on_rate.numerator: final requested ON states for the component
policy_on_rate.denominator: all deployment states in the named panel

selective_semantic_accuracy.numerator: resolved semantic decisions matching a separately resolved candidate-suitability oracle
selective_semantic_accuracy.denominator: states where both runtime semantic decision and oracle are resolved
selective_semantic_accuracy.guardrail: must be reported beside semantic_resolution_coverage; accuracy without coverage is invalid

false_on_rate.numerator: resolved OFF_ONLY or DO_NOT_OPEN states requested ON
false_on_rate.owner: PM only when Rank-1 and oracle are valid

false_off_rate.owner: PM or semantic abstention, reported separately by OFF reason

always_off_alias_rate.numerator: states where learned_pm_qualified action equals M0+R0
always_off_alias_rate.interpretation: a high value is not success; if the learned arm has no nonalias contrast or measurable benefit over always_off, no PM-value claim is allowed

requested_realized_functional_funnel.denominators: each stage reports both all-state and prior-stage conditional denominators

anti_gaming_guards: never report one global OFF rate without component and OFF-reason decomposition
never treat paired experimental arm allocation as a policy ON/OFF rate
never treat Rank-1 presence as semantic applicability or ON gold
report semantic coverage beside selective accuracy
compare learned routing against always_off and cost-and-ON-rate-matched random
if learned actions alias always_off, retain the alias and prohibit a semantic-selection benefit claim

responsibility_order.out_of_support: scope/OOD; report abstention rather than error unless a coverage target was preregistered

current_evidence_snapshot.formal_576_pair_arm_rate: 50 percent OFF by experimental construction; forbidden as a policy-rate estimate

required_before_external_policy_executio: runtime semantic abstention and OOD rules are machine-executable and frozen
each learned head has clean bidirectional support across at least 12 independent clusters
every failed head maps to FIXED_OFF in learned_pm_qualified
action and OFF-reason trace is materialized before response outcomes are opened
